definitions.explanation: The period or state before a surgical operation. Used as both a standalone noun and as a modifier (術前の) to describe examinations, preparations, or conditions that occur prior to surgery.

examples.japanese: {術前|じゅつぜん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
{術前|じゅつぜん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{控|ひか}える→控える：10054_hikaeru⟧よう⟦{指示|しじ}→指示：09674_shiji⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was instructed to refrain from eating before surgery.

examples.japanese: ⟦{医師|いし}→医師：11851_ishi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{術前|じゅつぜん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦リスク→リスク：06752_risuku⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{詳|くわ}しく→詳しい：02483_kuwashii⟧⟦{話|はな}して→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: The doctor explained the surgical risks in detail during the preoperative briefing.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{術|じゅつ}→術：14265_jutsu⟧ (technique, here short for ⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧, surgery) and ⟦{前|ぜん}→前〜：03957_zen⟧ (before). A medical term commonly used in hospitals and clinical settings. Often used as a modifier with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {術前|じゅつぜん}⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧: preoperative examination
- {術前|じゅつぜん}⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧: preoperative explanation/briefing
- {術前|じゅつぜん}⟦{診察|しんさつ}→診察：03259_shinsatsu⟧: preoperative consultation
- {術前|じゅつぜん}⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧: preoperative preparation
